tools.name: weight_memory
tools.description: Use this tool to compare weight precision assumptions. Returns model weight memory in decimal GB and binary GiB, excluding KV cache, activations and runtime overhead.

tools.name: facility_energy
tools.description: Use this tool to model a facility energy scenario. Returns PUE-adjusted facility power in kW, energy in kWh and illustrative electricity cost in USD.

tools.name: token_cost
tools.description: Use this tool to compare the unit economics of inference scenarios. Returns an illustrative cost in USD per million completed tokens from your cost and output assumptions.

tools.name: get_gpu_early_access
tools.description: Return Aguasto Console links for sign-in, Spot and On-Demand catalogue availability, and nonbinding Vera Rubin interest.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "weight_memory" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Estimate model weight memory in decimal GB and binary GiB; excludes KV cache, activations and runtime overhead." → after: "Use this tool to compare weight precision assumptions. Returns model weight memory in decimal GB and binary GiB, excluding KV cache, activations and runtime overhead."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
